_about: The /offers/ hub and its /offers/{activity}/ pages (OffersHub). Copy only: which offers appear comes from offers.json. Placeholders are filled from the page's own live offers: {count} offers, {priced} how many of them publish a paid price, {min}/{max} lowest and highest paid upfront price (free offers are left out of these three), {dmin}/{dmax} shortest and longest pass in days. A sentence or FAQ whose placeholder has no value is dropped, never printed half-filled. 'index' pages are indexable and in the sitemap only while they have at least min_index live offers; below that they stay up (noindex) with an honest empty state. Keep claims to what the cards themselves show; no studio names here, because offers change monthly.

hub.title: Perth Wellness Offers & Intro Deals | Oria Haven
hub.description: Compare {count} current intro passes, first-visit deals and wellness specials in Perth, each checked on the business’s own site, with prices and conditions upfront.
hub.intro: Compare intro passes, first-visit deals and wellness specials across Perth. Each one is checked on the business’s own website, with the price, what’s included and who can buy it upfront.

guide.p: The large price on each card is what you pay to start. Where an offer is a percentage or a buy-one-get-one, the total depends on what you book, so the card says “Price varies” instead of guessing.
Most intro offers are for new customers only, once per person. The line under the price says so when the business does; where it says nothing, ask before you buy.
Day passes run either from your first visit or from the day you buy. The terms on each card say which when the business states it.

guide.h: Look at the end date and the source
guide.p: Every card shows when we last checked the offer on the business’s site, and its end date if there is one. Offers come off this page the day after they end.

faq.q: Where do these offers come from?
faq.a: Most are read on the business’s own website or the booking page it links to, never from deal sites or social media; those cards link to that page and show the date we checked it. Cards marked “Added by the business” come from the business itself, through its Oria Haven listing. We check a business’s first offer before it appears.

faq.q: Are any of these offers paid placements?
faq.a: Businesses can pay to have an offer promoted. A promoted offer is always labelled “Promoted” on its card. Everything else is ordered by us, and no business pays to be included.

faq.q: How often is this page updated?
faq.a: Offers are re-checked every month, and an offer with an end date comes off the page the day after it ends. If something has changed, use “Report a problem” on the card.
The offer is a discount or a buy-one-get-one, so what you pay depends on what you book. We don’t work out a price the business hasn’t published.

yoga.label: Yoga
yoga.title: Yoga Intro Offers Perth: Compare Passes | Oria Haven
yoga.description: Compare {count} yoga intro passes from Perth studios, from {min}: pass length, classes included and who can buy one, each checked on the studio’s own site.
yoga.intro: Most Perth yoga studios welcome new students with an intro pass: a set number of days of classes for one price, sold once per person. Compare {count} current passes by price, length and what’s included.
yoga.guide_title: Before you buy a yoga intro pass

guide.p: Some passes count from your first class, others from the day you buy. The terms on each card say which when the studio does; if a card doesn’t, ask before you pay, so the clock doesn’t start before you can use it.
Intro passes are almost always for students new to that studio, once per person. Some add conditions, such as where you live. The line under the price shows them.
Check whether mat and towel hire are included, especially at hot yoga studios, where you’ll want both every class.
Check what you’ll pay afterwards (a class pack, casual rate or membership) and whether anything renews by itself. Where a card doesn’t mention it, ask the studio.

faq.q: How much is a yoga intro pass in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid passes here with a published price cost from {min} to {max}, checked on each studio’s own site.

faq.q: How long do yoga intro passes last?
faq.a: From {dmin} to {dmax} days for the passes on this page.

faq.q: Can I use an intro pass if I’ve been to the studio before?
faq.a: Usually not. Studios sell intro passes to new students, once per person, and most say so in their terms.

pilates.label: Pilates
pilates.title: Pilates Intro Offers Perth: Compare Trials | Oria Haven
pilates.description: Compare {count} Pilates intro offers in Perth, from {min}: reformer trial passes and class packs, with what’s included and who can buy them.
pilates.intro: Reformer studios usually start new clients on a short unlimited pass or a small pack of classes. Compare {count} current Pilates offers by upfront price, pass length and conditions.
pilates.guide_title: Before you book a Pilates trial

guide.p: A pass gives you a set number of days; a pack gives you a set number of classes. If you can only get to two classes a week, a pack may suit better than a short pass.
Reformer classes have a fixed number of machines, so popular times fill. Look at the timetable before you buy, so the trial runs in a week you can use.
Trials are for clients new to that studio, and most can be bought once. The line under the price shows the studio’s condition.
Check what classes cost afterwards and whether anything renews by itself. Where a card doesn’t mention it, ask the studio.

faq.q: How much is a Pilates intro offer in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid offers here with a published price cost from {min} to {max} upfront, checked on each studio’s own site.

faq.q: Do Pilates intro passes include reformer classes?
faq.a: Most offers here are from reformer studios; the inclusions on each card say which classes the offer covers.

spa.label: Spa
spa.title: Spa Specials Perth: Compare Packages | Oria Haven
spa.description: Compare {count} day spa specials in Perth: packages and first-visit discounts, with the treatments included, weekday conditions and end dates.
spa.intro: Day spa specials are usually a package of several treatments for one price, or a discount on a set menu, often limited to weekdays. Compare {count} current specials by price, what’s included and when you can book.
spa.guide_title: Before you book a spa special

guide.p: Packages differ more than their names suggest. Read the inclusions on each card: a package may not include a hands-on massage even when it sounds like it.
Many specials are for weekdays only and exclude public holidays. The condition line under the price shows it.
Some specials need a code when you book online; most can’t be combined with other offers or vouchers.

faq.q: How much are spa packages in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid specials here with a fixed price cost from {min} to {max}, checked on each spa’s own site.

faq.q: Can I use a spa special on the weekend?
faq.a: Check the condition on each card: some specials are for Monday to Friday only.

sauna.label: Sauna & recovery
sauna.title: Sauna & Recovery Deals Perth | Oria Haven
sauna.h1: Sauna and recovery offers in Perth
sauna.description: Compare {count} sauna, cold plunge and float offers in Perth: intro passes, session packs and specials, with what’s included and who can buy them.
sauna.intro: Recovery studios (infrared and traditional saunas, cold plunges, float tanks and compression) sell intro passes, session packs and seasonal specials. Compare {count} current offers by upfront price and what’s included.
sauna.guide_title: Before you buy a recovery pass

guide.p: A pass may cover every modality at the studio or only some. The inclusions on each card list what the business says the offer covers.
Some studios book private rooms, others shared spaces. If it matters to you, check the studio’s booking page before you buy.
Even with a pass, most studios ask you to book each session, and popular times fill.

faq.q: How much is a sauna intro pass in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid offers here with a fixed price cost from {min} to {max} upfront, checked on each studio’s own site.

faq.q: Do these offers include ice baths?
faq.a: Some do. The inclusions on each card list the sessions the business says the offer covers.

massage.label: Massage
massage.title: Massage Specials Perth: Compare Offers | Oria Haven
massage.description: Compare {count} massage specials in Perth: first-visit discounts, prepaid packs and spa packages, with conditions and end dates upfront.
massage.intro: Massage specials in Perth are mostly a discount on your first visit, a prepaid pack of sessions, or a spa package with a massage in it. Compare {count} current offers by price, what’s included and the conditions.
massage.guide_title: Before you book a massage special

guide.p: A remedial massage clinic and a day spa are different visits. The listing says which kind of business it is, and the inclusions on the card say what the session covers.
If you plan to claim from your health fund, ask before you book: some specials can’t be combined with preferred-provider discounts.
Prepaid packs have to be used within a set time. Where the business states it, the card or its terms say how long.
Some specials apply only at certain times of day or on weekdays, and public-holiday surcharges may still apply. The condition line under the price shows it.

faq.q: How much is a massage special in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid specials here with a fixed price cost from {min} to {max}. The rest are discounts, where the price depends on what you book, or don’t publish a price.

faq.q: Can I claim a massage special on my health fund?
faq.a: It depends on the business and your fund. Some specials can’t be combined with preferred-provider discounts, so ask the clinic before you book.

fitness.label: Fitness
fitness.title: Fitness Trials & Intro Offers Perth | Oria Haven
fitness.h1: Fitness trials and intro offers in Perth
fitness.description: Compare {count} fitness intro offers in Perth, including free trials: martial arts, boxing, reformer Pilates and more, with what’s included and who can join.
fitness.intro: Gyms and studios around Perth let new members try before they commit: a free class, a short unlimited pass or a pack of sessions. Compare {count} current offers by upfront price, length and what happens afterwards.
fitness.guide_title: Before you start a fitness trial

guide.p: A free trial is usually a single class. A paid intro pass gives you a run of classes, which is a better test of whether the timetable fits your week.
Some offers move onto a weekly membership when they end. Where the business says so, the card shows it under “After”; otherwise ask about lock-in contracts and cancellation before you sign up.
Intro offers are almost always for people new to that gym or studio, and some exclude anyone who has already used a trial there.

faq.q: Are there free fitness trials in Perth?
faq.a: Yes. Some offers on this page are a free first class or session: look for “Free” as the price on the card, or choose “Under $50” in Budget.

faq.q: How much is a fitness intro offer in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid offers here with a published price cost from {min} to {max} upfront, checked on each business’s own site.

beauty.label: Beauty
beauty.title: Beauty & Skin Specials Perth | Oria Haven
beauty.h1: Beauty and skin specials in Perth
beauty.description: Compare {count} beauty and skin specials in Perth: facials, lashes, tanning and first-visit offers, with the price, inclusions and conditions upfront.
beauty.intro: Beauty and skin clinics in Perth run first-visit offers, monthly specials and treatment packages. Compare {count} current specials by price, what’s included and who can book them.
beauty.guide_title: Before you book a beauty special

guide.p: Many skin offers are for first visits only, or start with a consultation. The line under the price says who can book.
A package price covers the treatments listed on the card. Add-ons are usually extra.
Some treatments aren’t offered to everyone, for example soon after injectables, and the clinic may ask questions before it books you. The terms on each card list what the business says.

faq.q: How much are beauty specials in Perth?
faq.a: The {priced} paid specials here with a published price cost from {min} to {max}. The rest are discounts, free sessions, or don’t publish a price.

faq.q: Are there free skin consultations in Perth?
faq.a: Some clinics on this page offer first-time clients a free consultation or skin session. Look for “Free” as the price on the card.
